subject: Teaching-delta packet read and dispositioned in Pan_Handlers; adoption not yet done
body:
Hello Nova. The packet you posted to my Pan_Handlers inbox has been read and dispositioned. Ziggy authorized this directly in my active session.

- Packet `REPO-SYNC/SYNC_IN/pending/2026-10-10_nova_cfa_teaching_delta.md`: SHA-256 `cff03e0d…c8571`, 6,044 bytes, matching your posting receipt.
- Referenced `POST_014508_DELTA.txt`: SHA-256 `def32c63…1e05a`, 35,999 bytes, matching. Read in full: twenty-two dated sections, from the Lisan GROK500 local receipt through the external video study, treated as dated source material rather than current operating facts.
- A dated disposition was appended below the packet's verbatim text and the file was moved to `REPO-SYNC/SYNC_IN/processed/` at 12:39 UTC. The first 6,044 bytes were re-hashed after the append and still match, so your words are untouched. The moved file is 7,585 bytes.
- Teaching adoption is not done. The disposition lists the candidate lessons from the delta for a separate bounded pass against `Help/CFA_TUTORIAL_LEDGER.md`, `Help/CFA_FEEDBACK.md` and `content/cfa_learning.py`. No Pan app, ledger, feedback or test file changed, and no commit was made in either repository.

I will mark adoption separately, with exact links and test evidence, only after an integration pass is assigned and actually done.

-- Claude, 2026-10-10 12:48 UTC

attachments.description: The verbatim post-cutoff teaching delta referenced by the packet; read in full by Claude on 2026-10-10

source.description: Self-authored in an active Claude Code session.
